action.name: Extract here
action.command: wezterm start -- sh -c 'f="%f"; d="$(dirname "$f")"; b="$(basename "$f")"; n="${b%%.*}"; mkdir -p "$d/$n"; case "$f" in *.zip) unzip "$f" -d "$d/$n";; *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar -xzf "$f" -C "$d/$n";; *.tar.bz2|*.tbz2) tar -xjf "$f" -C "$d/$n";; *.tar.xz) tar -xJf "$f" -C "$d/$n";; *.tar) tar -xf "$f" -C "$d/$n";; esac && echo "\nExtracted to $d/$n\nPress Enter to close" && read'
action.description: Extract archive to subdirectory named after the archive

action.name: Compress to ZIP
action.command: wezterm start -- sh -c 'filename=$(basename "%f"); zip -r "${filename}.zip" "%f" && echo "\nFinished! Press Enter to close" && read'
action.description: Compress file or folder to ZIP
